definition: A purchased Major Arcana card. Pay 3 Essence, of any type, when it is drawn to add it to your Arcanum, or discard it. It persists across Ages and counts as a Harvest Source. Limit two.
One complete cycle of play, made of Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter. An Age is what other games would call a round.
The player holding the Agekeeper's Key. They set the Cosmic Age, manage the deck, and reset the board. The Key passes clockwise each Age.
The recipe printed on a Crucible Card, calling for an Attunement, Reagents, and Furnace Heat. Completing one Fires your Stone into the Forge.
The comparison of your Aspects against the Aspects of an Age. Alignment drives both the Harvest and the Siege.
Position 8 at the center of the Great Year Board. The first Stone to reach it wins the game.
The price of declaring a Siege: Reagents equal in number to the Shield Reagents guarding the target Stone, in any combination of Elements. An Attacker who loses the Siege forfeits it to the supply.
The tableau zone holding your active Major Arcana cards.
The Sign, ruling Planet, and Element of an Age.

A token built on your Sign, crafted from 3 cards matching that Sign's ruling Planet. It is a Harvest Source, and it may fill one Attunement slot per Firing without being spent. It may be upgraded to an Astral Mansion.

An Astral House upgraded for 2 additional cards of its Sign's ruling Planet, marked with a Reagent token from the supply beneath it. Doubles the House's Alignment score at the Harvest and in a Siege; does not stack with other doubling effects.
A count of Element and Planet slots printed on a Crucible Card. Paid from Spread cards, which are spent, or from Astral Houses, which are not. Required alongside Reagents and Heat to Fire a Formula.
A shared reference area on the board listing every fixed exchange rate in the game. Formula costs still vary by Crucible Card.
+2 added to a Defender's total in any later Siege against this Stone for the rest of its current Transmutation Stage. Each successful defense adds another +2.
To send a card to the Kismeta discard pile. The loser of a revealed Siege burns every Hand card they committed to it.
The Spring rule freezing cards in their zones. From Card Lock until Winter, cards cannot move between your Hand and your Spread, though they may still be spent, crafted, traded, or committed.
A player-colored disc crafted from 3 cards of one suit, matching a Furnace's Element. Each Coal in a Furnace raises its owner's Heat by +1 in that Element.
The reference panel in front of each player on the Great Year Board. Shows the Coal and Reagent costs.
The Sign set by the Agekeeper at the start of each Age, and the Aspects that follow from it.

Spending a set of cards from your Spread to produce Coal or an Astral House. Coal takes 3 cards of one suit; an Astral House takes 3 cards of one Planet. The costs are printed on your Codex and the Bazaar.
A red-backed card bearing an Alchemical Formula. Each player holds four.
The numeric value of a Minor Arcana card, from 1 for an Ace to 14 for a King.
To spend 5 Essence of one Element and take the Reagent of that Element. Available on your turn in Summer, Autumn, and Winter.
A Summer contest of Zodiac Dice to steal a card from a rival's Spread.
Fire, Water, Air, or Earth. Every Sign, suit, Furnace, Reagent, and Essence has one.
The base currency, paid out at the Harvest in the Element of the Cosmic Age. Five Essence of one Element Distill into one Reagent.
To remove one Coal from a Furnace. It returns to its owner's supply and their Heat in that Element drops by 1. A Ward can stop it.
A Major Arcana card that resolves the moment it is drawn. Some carry an effect lasting until Transit. Fates cost nothing, carry no Aspects, and are returned to the discard pile at Transit.
The Autumn action of completing an Alchemical Formula to send your Stone from the Mantle Ring into the Forge, beginning a Transmutation Stage.
The space a Stone occupies during a Transmutation Stage. A Stone in the Forge is exposed to Siege for one Summer, guarded by whatever Shield Reagents its owner committed.
One of four shared Elemental spaces, each holding three Coal. You may fuel only the Furnace matching your Sign's Element.
The 1 Essence every player takes in Spring, matching the Cosmic Age's Element.
The central objective: to be the first Alchemist to advance a Philosopher's Stone through all four Transmutation Stages to the Altar of Kismeta.
The full arc of a single game of Kismeta, one grand cosmic cycle. Each round of play is one Cosmic Age within it.

The private tableau zone. Hand card effects are inactive and cannot be used in Crafting sets, but Hand cards may be committed in a Siege, where the loser of a revealed Siege burns the cards they committed to it.
The Autumn payout of Essence, scored by comparing each of your Harvest Sources against the Aspects of the Cosmic Age.
Anything you own that Aligns with the Cosmic Age to earn Essence at the Harvest. Your Harvest Sources are your Zodiac Die, your Astral Houses, your Adept Cards, and your Spread Cards.
Your personal Heat level in an Element, raised +1 by each Coal you own in that Furnace, to a maximum of 3 (Radiant). Formulas call for a level of Heat.
A blue-backed card, either Minor Arcana or Major Arcana.
The 22 special cards in the Kismeta Deck: 12 Adepts and 10 Fates. They are held in the Arcanum.
The track your Stone advances along, from START through four Transmutation Stages to the Altar of Kismeta.
The 112 standard cards in the Kismeta Deck, 28 per suit. Each carries a Rank, a CV, a Suit, a Planet, and a printed Effect.
To cancel the Reversed effect of a card in your Spread. Both cards remain in play.
When a single source matches all three Aspects of the Cosmic Age at once (Sign, Planet, and Element) it scores the full stack.
Each player's primary game piece. It begins on START and must reach the Altar of Kismeta to win. It may be Resting, Forging, or in Stasis at any given time.

A refined token distilled from 5 Essence of one Element. Reagents pay Formulas, shield a Stone in the Forge, and pay the Ante to declare a Siege. The four types are Sulfur, Vitriol, Quicksilver, and Aqua Regia.
The Autumn action of paying 5 Essence, of any type, to return a Seized Stone from Stasis to its previous Forge position.
An Adept's enhanced tier, active while the Cosmic Age shares one of its three Aspects. Use its Resonant text in place of Base while this holds.
A penalty that applies only while the card bearing it sits in your Spread. Moving it to your Hand, or Neutralizing it, ends the penalty.
To look at the top X cards of the Kismeta Deck, or at a rival's Hand, as the card states. What you learn is yours to keep.
The state of a Stone that lost a Siege. It moves to a nearby Stasis zone and must be Rekindled.
To switch off one card's printed text until Transit.
A Reagent committed to the Forge beside your Stone as you Fire it, up to 3. Rivals must match their number as an Ante to Siege you, and you take them back when you Temper.
A Summer attack on a rival's Stone while it sits in the Forge, resolved by Alignment with a chance for either side to concede before the reveal.
One of the twelve Zodiac Signs. Your Sign is set each Spring and holds for the Age.
The public tableau zone. Spread card effects are active; they may be used in Crafting sets, and they can be lost in Duels.
Where a Seized Stone is held. From the Autumn of the next Age, its owner may pay 5 Essence to Rekindle it, and it waits there until they can. Marked with a ❄️ snowflake symbol.
One of four categories on Minor Arcana cards: Wands, Cups, Pentacles, or Swords. Each corresponds to an Element, a Reagent, and a Furnace.
Everything you have in play: your Spread, Hand, and Arcanum.
The Autumn action of advancing a Stone that has spent a full Age in the Forge to the next Mantle Ring position, setting aside its Crucible Card and consuming the Coal it used.
Definition
A Summer action in which players freely exchange Adept Cards, Astral Houses, Essence, Kismeta Cards, and Reagents. Crucible Cards, Fate Cards, and Coal cannot be traded.
The final step of Winter. Duration effects end, Fate Cards are discarded, and the Agekeeper's Key and Cosmic Age Die pass to the next player.
One step along the Mantle Ring, begun by Firing the Stone and completed by Tempering it.
A protection printed on certain cards. The warded card, Stone, or resource cannot be targeted, as the card states.
Your personal 12-sided die. Roll it in Spring to set your Sign for the Age. That Sign holds for Harvests and Sieges alike until the Age ends.
The ring of twelve Signs on the Great Year Board, showing each Sign's ruling Planet, Element, and Harvest scoring values.
